dog.description_text: Cherry is the sweetest one in the bunch! She is gentle, loving, and easy-going -- extra floofy, and extra cuddly! Cherry loves snuggling up on the couch, playing tug-o-war with her foster sister, and lazing around on the floor in every room. Cherry is going to be a BIG girl, and is already growing very fast. She is food motivated, doesn't mind being groomed, and loves to slurp up lots of water (which comes with really cute hiccups). Cherry is just now discovering toys and treats for the first time, and is curious about every nook and cranny she can crawl into! Cherry would be the perfect fit for a growing family, who hopefully has a yard for her to patrol. ﻿Cherry is approximately 0y 2m 22d old and may be 100 to 120 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done. Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog. This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
